title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
title_zh: Reglos：具备递归自我改进的自演化个人记忆智能体

paragraphs.en: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model’s context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user’s append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With the same backbone behind every system, Reglos outperforms state-of-the-art memory systems such as Mem0, MemOS and EverOS, reaching 61.3% and 84.0% on PersonaMem-v2 and LongMemEval-S with Qwen3.8-27B, and 57.5% and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna.

paragraphs.en: A personal assistant that talks with the same user for months has to keep track of what that user prefers ( Hu et al. 2025 ; Jiang et al. 2025b ) . Some of those preferences change, and the user may later ask the assistant to forget others. Reading the whole history handles this poorly, and even frontier models often miss a preference the user only implied or keep applying one that has changed ( Jiang et al. 2025b ) . Memory systems keep what each user says across conversations and recall it when the model answers ( Packer et al. 2023 ; Chhikara et al. 2025 ; Rasmussen et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) . How well they work depends on what they store and on the code that decides what to recall and how to show it to the model, which we call the harness .
paragraphs.zh: 与同一用户交谈数月的个人助理必须跟踪该用户的偏好 ( Hu et al. 2025 ; Jiang et al. 2025b ) 。 其中一些偏好会发生变化，用户之后也可能要求智能体遗忘另一些偏好。 通读全部历史记录对这种情况的处理效果很差，即使是前沿模型也常常会遗漏用户仅间接暗示的偏好，或继续应用已经改变的偏好 ( Jiang et al. 2025b ) 。 记忆系统会保存每个用户在跨对话中所说的内容，并在模型回答时将其召回 ( Packer et al. 2023 ; Chhikara et al. 2025 ; Rasmussen et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) 。 它们效果的好坏取决于所存储的内容，也取决于决定召回什么以及如何将其呈现给模型的代码，我们将其称为外部框架（harness）。

paragraphs.en: Although these systems update what they store as the user talks, the harness itself is usually written by hand and revised between releases. Recent work hands that job to coding agents, which evolve memory programs and pipelines against benchmarks ( Liu et al. 2026b ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ) . A benchmark score alone leaves one question open: does a change help users whose failures nobody inspected while writing it?
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些系统会随着用户交谈而更新其存储的内容，但测试框架本身通常由人工编写，并在版本发布之间进行修改。 最近的工作将这项任务交给了编码智能体，它们会基于基准测试来演化记忆程序和流水线（Liu et al. 2026b; Chen et al. 2026; Zhang et al. 2025）。 仅有基准测试的分数仍留下一个悬而未决的问题：某项改动是否真的帮助了那些失败从未在编写时被人工检查过的用户？

paragraphs.en: Our own development data show why that question matters. A memory can be stored correctly and still be used wrongly: in 31% of the failures we traced, the evidence the model needed was already in its context (Section 4.1 ). Those are failures of the harness, and a coding agent can patch them, but a patch judged on the cases that prompted it can look better than it is. A prompt-only search over the harness text in the style of GEPA ( Agrawal et al. 2026 ) gained 3.8 points on the questions it was selected on and 1.1 on questions it had never seen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们自己的开发数据说明了这个问题为何重要。 一段记忆可以被正确存储，却仍然被错误使用：在我们追踪的 31% 失败案例中，模型所需的证据其实已经在其上下文中（见 4.1 节）。 这些属于测试框架的失败，编程智能体可以为它们打补丁，但仅依据触发补丁的案例来评判补丁，可能会让它的表现显得比实际更好。 一场以 GEPA 风格（Agrawal et al. 2026）在测试框架文本上进行的仅提示词搜索，在其被选中的问题上提升了 3.8 分，而在它从未见过的问题上仅提升 1.1 分。

paragraphs.en: These failures point to two kinds of change with different owners. A user’s memory changes whenever that user talks, and an error in it is best fixed then, inside that user’s record. The harness serves every user at once, so a change to it can help some users and hurt others, and that is where overfitting happens. We therefore argue that a personal memory system should improve at two time scales: its memory online as each user talks, and its harness offline through changes that a fixed evaluator accepts only after testing them on held-out users.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败指向两类变更，分别属于不同的责任方。 用户记忆会在该用户每次对话时发生变化，其中的错误最好在当时、在该用户的记录内部修复。 而框架同时服务所有用户，对它的改动可能让一些用户受益、另一些用户受损，这正是过拟合发生之处。 因此我们主张，一个个人记忆系统应当在两个时间尺度上改进：在线上，随着每个用户的对话改进其记忆；在线下，通过变更改进其框架，而这些变更只有在留出用户上测试通过后，才能由固定的评估器接受。

paragraphs.en: We present Reglos , a training-free personal memory agent built on this principle (Figure 2 ). Its inner loop is a self-evolving memory. Each fact enters an append-only record that stores when it holds and when it was learned, so a new preference can supersede an old one without erasing it. A request to forget expires the matching facts, and a nightly pass rewrites the profile from the user’s current facts. Because these states are explicit, the harness can tell the model which of two conflicting preferences is current and what it must not use. Its outer loop improves the harness through recursive self-improvement. A coding agent reads failure traces and writes patches, and a critic from a second model family clusters the same failures and rejects patches that game the benchmark. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator accepts a patch only if it helps users held out from development. The two loops co-evolve. The outer loop learns from the failures of the memory the inner loop builds, and each accepted patch changes how that memory is written and read. Qwen3.8-27B writes memory throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Reglos，一个基于此原则构建的无需训练的个人记忆智能体（图 2）。 其内循环是一个自我演化的记忆。 每条事实都会进入一个只追加的记录，该记录存储事实何时成立以及何时被学习，因此新的偏好可以取代旧的偏好而不将其抹除。 忘记请求会使匹配的事实过期失效，并且每夜的例行处理会根据用户当前的事实重写档案。 由于这些状态是显式的，测试框架可以告诉模型两个冲突的偏好中哪一个是当前的，以及它不能使用什么。 其外循环通过递归自我改进来优化测试框架。 一个编码智能体阅读失败轨迹并编写补丁，来自第二个模型家族的评审模型对同样的失败进行聚类，并拒绝那些投机取巧钻基准空子的补丁。 在测试框架被冻结后，一个固定的评估器只有在补丁对未参与开发的用户有帮助时才会接受它。两个循环协同演化。 外循环从内循环所构建的记忆的失败中学习，而每个被接受的补丁都会改变该记忆的写入和读取方式。 全程使用 Qwen3.8-27B 来写入记忆。

paragraphs.en: With Qwen3.8-27B writing memory for every system, Reglos outperforms Mem0, MemOS and EverOS on PersonaMem-v2, LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo, whether Qwen3.8-27B or GPT-5.6 Luna answers (Figure 1 ). On the official PersonaMem-v2 benchmark split it reaches 61.3%, 7.5 points above the strongest of them; the best published result we found is 57.2%, obtained with a GPT-4.1-mini reader ( Liu et al. 2026c ) . On LongMemEval-S it reaches 84.0%, 3.6 points above EverOS. With GPT-5.6 Luna answering, it scores 57.5% and 87.2% and again leads both benchmarks. Within the outer loop, the coding agent’s accepted patches lift the harness from 54.2% to 60.7% on the validation questions.

paragraphs.en: Early memory for LLM agents paged information in and out of a bounded context ( Packer et al. 2023 ) or kept a stream of observations with periodic reflection ( Park et al. 2023 ) . Production systems now extract and reconcile facts ( Chhikara et al. 2025 ) , build temporal knowledge graphs ( Rasmussen et al. 2025 ) , link notes ( Xu et al. 2025 ) or manage memory as an operating system ( Li et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) ; Hu et al. (2025) survey the space. Benchmarks have moved from recalling facts in long dialogues ( Maharana et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2025 ) to inferring implicit, evolving preferences ( Jiang et al. 2025a ; Jiang et al. 2025b ) and to long agent trajectories ( Zhao et al. 2026 ) . Two diagnostic studies shape our evaluation. Most memory systems fall below naive retrieval over the raw history on PersonaMem-v2 ( He et al. 2026 ) , so we report raw retrieval with our own answer policy as a control. On LoCoMo, most failures arise at retrieval (Yuan et al. 2026 ); on PersonaMem-v2 we find most reachable failures after retrieval, when the answering model already holds the evidence (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 早期的LLM智能体记忆将信息在有界上下文中换入换出（Packer et al. 2023），或保存观察流并周期性地进行反思（Park et al. 2023）。 生产系统如今会抽取并调和事实（Chhikara et al. 2025）、构建时序知识图谱（Rasmussen et al. 2025）、链接笔记（Xu et al. 2025），或将记忆当作操作系统来管理（Li et al. 2025; Hu et al. 2026）；Hu et al.（2025）对该领域做了综述。 基准测试已从在长对话中回忆事实（Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2025），发展到推断隐含且不断演化的偏好（Jiang et al. 2025a; Jiang et al. 2025b），再到长的智能体轨迹（Zhao et al. 2026）。 两项诊断性研究塑造了我们的评估。 在PersonaMem-v2上（He et al. 2026），大多数记忆系统的表现低于对原始历史的朴素检索，因此我们以原始检索加上我们自己的回答策略作为对照进行报告。 在LoCoMo上，大多数失败发生在检索阶段（Yuan et al. 2026）；而在PersonaMem-v2上，我们发现大多数可触及的失败出现在检索之后，即回答模型已经掌握证据之时（第4节）。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents improve from their own interaction data and feedback ( Gao et al. 2026 ; Fang et al. 2025 ) ; without retraining the underlying model, they reflect on failures ( Shinn et al. 2023 ; Madaan et al. 2023 ) , accumulate skills ( Wang et al. 2024 ) , or grow an evolving context or prompt ( Zhang et al. 2026d ; Agrawal et al. 2026 ) . MemEvolve meta-evolves how experience is encoded, stored and retrieved ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , EvolveMem tunes retrieval configurations from failure logs ( Liu et al. 2026a ) , MemSkill and SelfMem evolve memory skills and strategies ( Zhang et al. 2026b ; Yang et al. 2026 ) , and MindMemOS evolves memory schemas and consolidates them by dreaming ( Liang et al. 2026a ) ; Memory-R1, Mem- α \alpha and Mem-T instead train the memory manager with reinforcement learning ( Yan et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2025 ; Yue et al. 2026 ) . Reglos’s inner loop is self-evolution of this kind, applied per user under fixed rules (supersession that keeps history, retraction that records the request, and user edits).

paragraphs.en: In the sense of Duan et al. (2026) , recursive self-improvement (RSI) is an autonomous, closed loop whose changes persist and alter later improvement. One line of recent work trains the model inside that loop ( Lin et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026a ) . Another is training-free and evolves the harness around a frozen model ( Lee et al. 2026b ; Zhang et al. 2026c ; Lee et al. 2026a ) , and some systems combine the two ( Wei et al. 2026 ; Su et al. 2026 ) . RSI has also reached memory: MemPro, PrisMem and ALMA evolve the memory pipeline as code ( Liu et al. 2026b ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Xiong, Hu, and Clune 2026 ) , and D 2 ACCI gates memory changes with statistical tests ( Liu et al. 2026c ) . Reglos belongs to the training-free harness line, at the level of strategy autonomy: a coding agent proposes harness code, the task model stays frozen, and a fixed evaluator decides which changes to keep.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Duan 等人的意义上 （2026），递归自我改进（RSI）是一个自主的闭环，其变更会持久保存并影响后续的改进。 近期的一条工作路线是在该循环内训练模型（Lin 等 2026；Zhang 等 2026a）。 另一条路线是无需训练的，围绕冻结的模型演化外部框架（Lee 等 2026b；Zhang 等 2026c；Lee 等 2026a），还有一些系统将两者结合（Wei 等 2026；Su 等 2026）。 RSI 也已经扩展到记忆领域：MemPro、PrisMem 和 ALMA 将记忆流程作为代码进行演化（Liu 等 2026b；Chen 等 2026；Xiong、Hu 与 Clune 2026），而 D²ACCI 则用统计检验来把关记忆变更（Liu 等 2026c）。 Reglos 属于无需训练的框架路线，处于策略自主层面：由一个编码智能体提出框架代码，任务模型保持冻结，并由一个固定的评估器决定保留哪些变更。

paragraphs.en: Each user’s memory grows from what that user says. New messages wait in a buffer until there are enough to be worth reading, and the task model then extracts the facts, commitments and requests to forget that they contain. Before any of this text reaches a model, secrets such as keys and card numbers are masked. Once extracted, each candidate is compared with the facts already stored. One batch call then decides whether it is new, already known, a replacement for an older fact, or extra detail for one. The accepted facts are kept in the language the user spoke and indexed for recall.

paragraphs.en: Every fact keeps the identifiers of its source messages, a perspective (the user’s own belief, an objective fact, or something the assistant said) and two times: when the fact holds and when the system learned it. A fact’s text is never rewritten, so a change of mind closes the old fact’s validity and leaves it in the record, where the history of a preference stays readable. A request to forget expires the matching facts and records the request itself, which the harness later shows the model with the rule never to rely on it. Figure 3 follows one user through these cases. Users can also inspect, correct, delete and undo any memory in the app.
paragraphs.zh: 每条事实都保留其来源消息的标识符、一个视角（用户自己的信念、客观事实，或智能体说过的话），以及两个时间：事实生效的时间和系统了解到它的时间。 事实的文本从不改写，因此想法的改变会关闭旧事实的有效期并将其保留在记录中，偏好的历史因此始终可读。 要求遗忘的请求会使匹配的事实失效，并记录该请求本身，框架稍后会向智能体展示这一记录，并附上永不依赖它的规则。 图 3 跟踪了一位用户经历这些情形的过程。 用户还可以在应用中查看、更正、删除和撤销任何记忆。

paragraphs.en: The record is condensed as well as kept. Each night a pass called Dream summarizes the day’s sessions and rewrites the user’s profile from the facts that are still current. When a question arrives, recall searches the facts through six routes at once: three on content (vector, keyword and entity graph), two anchored on the time and place the question mentions, and recency. The content routes decide what can come back. Time, place and recency only raise facts that a content route has found, unless no content route finds anything, and a fact found by recency alone is dropped. The routes are fused by reciprocal rank fusion into a fixed token budget, and an explain call reports which route surfaced each item.

paragraphs.en: The kernel keeps every layer of memory, and the work queue that maintains it, in a single PostgreSQL 16 database. Recall scans each user’s rows exactly. One user holds a few hundred to a few thousand facts, and an approximate index filtered down to one user can silently return fewer of them than asked. Extraction and Dream run as jobs that workers lease from the same database, so several instances share the load and a job interrupted by a crash is picked up when its lease expires.

paragraphs.en: A candidate that matches a stored fact after normalization (case, width, spacing and punctuation) only confirms the stored row, with no model call. If the batch adjudication fails, every candidate is kept as new, so a model error can duplicate a fact but never lose one. Model calls back off for about three minutes on rate limits and server errors. paragraphs.zh: 候选在规范化（大小写、全半角、空格与标点）后若与已存事实匹配，则仅确认已存的记录，不调用模型。 如果批量裁决失败，所有候选都会保留为新条目，因此模型出错可能导致事实重复，但绝不会丢失事实。 遇到限流和服务器错误时，模型调用会退避约三分钟。 关闭模型的推理功能后，引擎每次模型调用只使用四分之一的输出 token，耗时 2.6 秒，而原来是 9.3 秒。

paragraphs.en: The harness is the program that sits between the memory kernel and the frozen task model and determines what the model reads. It receives the question, together with its answer options where the benchmark provides them, but has no access to the dataset’s labels. Memory is reachable only through a narrow interface: recall, the list of stored items, the user’s profile and the source messages of each fact. Within this interface the harness may issue several recall queries, filter and rank the results across memory layers, and decide how the evidence is organized. These decisions form the search space of the outer loop (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架（harness）是位于记忆内核与冻结的任务模型之间的程序，它决定模型读取什么内容。 它接收问题以及基准测试提供的答案选项，但无法访问数据集的标签。 记忆只能通过一个狭窄的接口访问：召回、已存储条目的列表、用户画像以及每条事实的来源消息。 在这个接口内，测试框架可以发出多个召回查询，跨记忆层对结果进行过滤和排序，并决定证据的组织方式。 这些决策构成了外层循环的搜索空间（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Each context opens with a memory-use policy and the user’s requests to forget, followed by the profile, the recalled facts with superseded ones marked as no longer true, and a small number of session summaries and raw excerpts. For multiple-choice questions the harness also retrieves evidence for each option. The options of a question typically share a template, so recall on the full option text returns nearly the same facts for all of them; the harness therefore queries with the terms that distinguish each option from the others. This per-option retrieval was the final step accepted by the outer loop (Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个上下文以记忆使用策略和用户的遗忘请求开头，随后是用户画像、召回的事实（其中已被取代的事实标注为不再为真），以及少量会话摘要和原始摘录。 对于多项选择题，测试框架还会为每个选项检索证据。 同一问题的各个选项通常共享一个模板，因此对完整选项文本的召回会为所有选项返回几乎相同的事实；因此测试框架使用能将每个选项与其他选项区分开的检索词进行查询。 这种针对每个选项的检索是外层循环所接受的最后一步（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The policy specifies how the model should interpret the states that the record encodes. The model must not rely on facts the user asked to forget or on preferences that are no longer current, and it must keep the preferences of other people separate from the user’s own. Further rules address what the record cannot encode: the memory is incomplete, preferences must not be inferred from demographic attributes, and sensitive identifiers must not appear in the answer. Appendix A gives the full policy.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略规定了模型应如何解释记录所编码的状态。 模型不得依赖用户要求遗忘的事实或已失效的偏好，并且必须将他人的偏好与用户自身的偏好区分开来。 更多规则涉及记录无法编码的内容：记忆是不完整的，不得从人口统计学属性推断偏好，且敏感标识符不得出现在答案中。 附录A给出了完整的策略。

paragraphs.en: We evolve the harness on PersonaMem-v2 ( Jiang et al. 2025b ) , whose four-way questions turn on implicit, revised or retracted preferences, on preferences that belong to someone else, and on information the user asked not to repeat. Qwen3.8-27B (reasoning off) writes memory and answers throughout. The loop sees only the validation split. We report all PersonaMem-v2 results on the official 5,000-question test set. We scored it once after the freeze and never read its failures (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 PersonaMem-v2（Jiang et al. 2025b）上对测试框架进行演化，其四选一的问题涉及隐式的、已修改或已撤回的偏好，属于他人的偏好，以及用户要求不要重复的信息。 Qwen3.8-27B（关闭推理）全程负责写入记忆并回答问题。 该循环仅能看到验证集。 我们在官方 5,000 题测试集上报告所有 PersonaMem-v2 的结果。 我们在冻结之后仅对其评分一次，且从未查看其失败案例（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: The proposer is the coding agent Claude Code ( Anthropic 2025 ) running Claude Opus 5.5. It reads raw failure traces and writes a patch to the harness, following the finding that raw traces carry more signal than summaries ( Lee et al. 2026b ) . The critic is Codex ( OpenAI 2025 ) running GPT-6.1 Sol, so the proposer and the critic come from different model families. The critic clusters the same failures independently and rejects any patch keyed to the dataset’s option templates or labels. A fixed evaluator then decides. After the freeze, every candidate faces the rule of Figure 4 : it must gain on each of two persona-disjoint validation halves (1,317 questions) and may cost a second reader at most one point; GPT-5.6 Luna is that reader and answers from the same contexts. Humans fix the objective, the splits and the rule; the proposer decides what to change. In the taxonomy of Duan et al. (2026) this is strategy autonomy (L2), and the inner loop is environment adaptation (L4); Appendix C maps both loops onto their components.
paragraphs.zh: 提出者是运行 Claude Opus 5.5 的编码智能体 Claude Code（Anthropic 2025）。 它读取原始失败轨迹并为测试框架撰写补丁，遵循原始轨迹比摘要携带更多信号这一发现（Lee et al. 2026b）。 评判者是运行 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Codex（OpenAI 2025），因此提出者与评判者来自不同的模型家族。 评判者独立地对相同的失败进行聚类，并拒绝任何与数据集的选项模板或标签相关联的补丁。 随后由一个固定的评估器做出决定。 冻结之后，每个候选方案都要面对图 4 的规则：它必须在两个角色不相交的验证半区（1,317 个问题）上各自取得提升，并且至多使第二名读者损失一分；GPT-5.6 Luna 就是这名读者，并基于相同的上下文作答。 人类确定目标、划分和规则；提出者决定要更改什么。 在 Duan et al. （2026）的分类法中，这是策略自主性（L2），而内循环是环境适应（L4）；附录 C 将两个循环映射到其各组件上。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.8-27B runs in non-thinking mode through Alibaba Cloud’s DashScope API, and qwen3.7-text-embedding supplies every embedding. The EverOS store for BEAM-100K and the no-memory LoCoMo row with Qwen3.8-27B used the same unquantized weights served locally. GPT-5.6 Luna answers with its default reasoning setting.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares each system in its standard configuration, with Qwen3.8-27B writing memory in every row and answering in its left half. Reglos reaches 61.3%, 7.5 points above the strongest competitor and 12.0 above the same model reading the full history. With GPT-5.6 Luna answering from the same memories, Reglos reaches 57.5%, 6.9 points above the strongest baseline and 12.9 above the full history. Two controls test whether our policy or our harness alone explains the lead. Our memory-use policy lifts every baseline by 3 to 6 points, and EverOS with the policy still trails Reglos by 2.5. Raw retrieval inside the Reglos harness scores 58.1%, so the memory pipeline adds 3.2 points under the same harness (Table 2 ), the comparison memory systems are asked to report ( He et al. 2026 ) . Under the official protocol the best published result we found is 57.2%, from MemStack with a GPT-4.1-mini reader ( Liu et al. 2026c ) .
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 在各系统的标准配置下进行比较，每一行都由 Qwen3.8-27B 写入记忆，并在左半部分作答。 Reglos 达到 61.3%，比最强的竞争对手高 7.5 分，比同一模型阅读完整历史时高 12.0 分。 当由 GPT-5.6 Luna 基于相同的记忆作答时，Reglos 达到 57.5%，比最强的基线高 6.9 分，比完整历史高 12.9 分。 两项对照实验用于检验这一领先究竟是由我们的策略还是我们的框架单独造成的。 我们的记忆使用策略将每个基线都提升了 3 至 6 分，而采用该策略的 EverOS 仍比 Reglos 落后 2.5 分。 在 Reglos 框架内使用原始检索得分为 58.1%，因此在相同框架下记忆流水线带来了 3.2 分的提升（表 2），这正是要求被对比的记忆系统所报告的内容（He et al. 2026）。 在官方协议下，我们找到的已发表最佳结果为 57.2%，来自使用 GPT-4.1-mini 阅读器的 MemStack（Liu et al. 2026c）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 breaks the results down by question type. On sensitive-information questions Reglos answers 91.4%, against 42.9% to 47.6% for the other memory systems. Where the user asked to forget, Reglos answers 63.1%, well ahead of EverOS (42.8%) and Mem0 (11.8%) and close to MemOS (61.3%). The tombstone and the memory-use policy target these two types, because they tell the reader what it must not use. On the five ordinary preference types EverOS is ahead on four, by 0.8 to 2.0 points on three and by 8.3 points on health conditions, and Reglos is ahead on therapy background. Split instead by whose preference a question turns on, one group is below chance for every system: preferences that belong to someone other than the user (19.0% to 20.5% on 522 questions).
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 按问题类型对结果进行了细分。 在敏感信息类问题上，Reglos 的正确率为 91.4%，而其他记忆系统为 42.9% 到 47.6%。 在用户要求遗忘的问题上，Reglos 的正确率为 63.1%，远高于 EverOS（42.8%）和 Mem0（11.8%），接近 MemOS（61.3%）。 墓碑机制和记忆使用策略针对这两类问题，因为它们告诉读取方什么是不应使用的。 在五个普通偏好类型上，EverOS 在四个类型上领先，其中三个类型领先 0.8 到 2.0 分，在健康状况上领先 8.3 分，而 Reglos 在治疗背景上领先。 若改为按问题所涉偏好归属来划分，有一组对所有系统都低于随机水平：属于用户以外他人的偏好（522 个问题上为 19.0% 到 20.5%）。

paragraphs.en: On the development slices we traced 159 failures of the task model to the layer responsible, with a stronger model checking each case (Table 3 ). In 48% the fact needed was never stated in the conversation, so no memory system could answer from the history; in 31% the evidence was in the context and the reader chose wrongly; in 16% the fact was in the conversation but never written to memory; in 4% it was written but not recalled. Among failures whose evidence exists in the history, reader errors form the largest group.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发切片上，我们借助一个更强的模型逐例核查，将 159 个任务模型失败 traced 到了相应层级（表 3）。 其中 48% 所需的事实从未在对话中提及，因此任何记忆系统都无法从历史中回答；31% 证据已在上下文中但读取方选错了；16% 事实在对话中但从未写入记忆；4% 已写入但未被召回。 在证据存在于历史中的失败里，读取方错误占最大一部分。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the other benchmarks. On LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al. 2025 ) Reglos reaches 84.0% with Qwen3.8-27B and 87.2% with GPT-5.6 Luna, ahead of the next system by 3.6 and 6.4 points. Without the 54 questions used during development Reglos stays first (83.4%, against 79.8% for raw retrieval and 79.4% for EverOS); ten EverOS questions that never finished processing count as wrong, which costs it at most 2.0 points. On a 100-question sample with the same model, Zep ( Rasmussen et al. 2025 ) answers 34.0%, against 79.0% for Reglos.
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了其他基准测试的结果。 在 LongMemEval-S（Wu et al. 2025）上，Reglos 使用 Qwen3.8-27B 达到 84.0%，使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 达到 87.2%，比排名第二的系统分别高出 3.6 和 6.4 分。 若不计开发阶段使用过的 54 个问题，Reglos 仍排名第一（83.4%，而原始检索为 79.8%，EverOS 为 79.4%）；EverOS 有十个从未完成处理的问题被计为错误，这使其最多损失 2.0 分。 在使用相同模型的 100 个问题样本上，Zep（Rasmussen et al. 2025）回答正确率为 34.0%，而 Reglos 为 79.0%。

paragraphs.en: With Qwen3.8-27B answering, Reglos ranks first on the two largest LongMemEval-S question types (Table 4 ): 76.7% against 72.9% for EverOS on multi-session questions and 84.2% against 83.5% on temporal ones. Its largest margin over EverOS is on what the assistant said earlier (98.2% against 67.9%). The extracted facts hold mostly what the user said, and Reglos keeps raw conversation excerpts beside them. Raw retrieval returns conversation rounds and reaches 100.0% on this type. Its one clear weakness is the 30 preference questions, where EverOS and Mem0 lead by 13 to 17 points. On LoCoMo with Qwen3.8-27B, Reglos leads the memory systems in every category, by 6.2 points on single-hop and 10.0 on multi-hop questions over EverOS (Table 7 ). At BEAM-500K with Qwen3.8-27B, Reglos is ahead of Mem0 on temporal reasoning, abstention and contradiction resolution, and Mem0 is ahead on multi-session reasoning and knowledge updates.
paragraphs.zh: 在使用 Qwen3.8-27B 作答时，Reglos 在 LongMemEval-S 最大的两类问题上排名第一（表 4）：在多会话问题上为 76.7%，高于 EverOS 的 72.9%；在时间类问题上为 84.2%，高于 83.5%。 它相对 EverOS 优势最大的是助手先前说过什么这一类（98.2% 对 67.9%）。 所抽取的事实主要包含用户说过的内容，而 Reglos 在这些事实旁边保留了原始对话摘录。 原始检索返回的是对话轮次，在此类问题上达到 100.0%。 它唯一明显的弱点是 30 个偏好问题，在该类上 EverOS 和 Mem0 领先 13 到 17 个百分点。 在 LoCoMo 上使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时，Reglos 在每个类别中都领先于各记忆系统，在单跳问题上比 EverOS 高 6.2 分，在多跳问题上高 10.0 分（表 7）。 在 BEAM-500K 上使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时，Reglos 在时间推理、拒答和矛盾消解方面领先于 Mem0，而 Mem0 在多会话推理和知识更新方面领先。

paragraphs.en: In the seed engine a message such as “please forget that I take sertraline” was stored as an emphasized memory, because the extraction prompt read it as a request to remember. On questions that test forgetting the correct option is the generic one, and the seed answered none of nine development cases. Retraction with a tombstone, and a policy line that forbids relying on anything listed as forgotten, raised this to eight of nine on development and twelve of fourteen on a held-out slice.
paragraphs.zh: 在种子引擎中，诸如“请忘记我在服用舍曲林”这样的消息被存储为一条被强调的记忆，因为抽取提示词将其解读为一条要求记住的请求。 在测试遗忘的问题上，正确选项是通用选项，而种子引擎在九个开发案例中一个也没有答对。 带有墓碑标记的撤回机制，以及一条禁止依赖任何被列为已遗忘内容的策略规定，将成绩提升到开发集九例中答对八例，在留出切片上十四例中答对十二例。

paragraphs.en: Many preferences sat in raw conversation excerpts without being extracted, and recall driven by the question could not reach them, because the question does not name the preference. Recall run once per answer option, with the words that distinguish that option, finds them. Together with the policy revision between them, the steps from v1 to v3 raised accuracy from 54% to 68% on a 50-question held-out slice.
paragraphs.zh: 许多偏好停留在未经提取的原始对话摘录中，由问题驱动的召回无法触及它们，因为问题并未点名该偏好。 对每个答案选项运行一次、以区分该选项的词语进行的召回，则能找到它们。 加上两者之间的策略修订，从 v1 到 v3 的步骤在 50 题的保留切片上将准确率从 54% 提升至 68%。

paragraphs.en: Writing one persona’s 32k-token history to memory costs about 225k to 260k task-model tokens (roughly 7.5 times the history) and 40k embedding tokens, amortized over 25 questions per persona. Answering costs about 6.0k prompt tokens per question, so judging one candidate on 1,317 questions with two readers takes about 16M prompt tokens. Writing memory for the 200 test personas took about 50M task-model tokens and six hours at eight-way concurrency.
paragraphs.zh: 将一个角色（persona）的 32k token 历史写入记忆，大约耗费 22.5 万至 26 万个任务模型 token（约为历史长度的 7.5 倍）以及 4 万个嵌入 token，该开销在每角色 25 个问题上摊销。 回答每个问题大约耗费 6k 个提示 token，因此用两名评审来评判一个候选方案在 1,317 个问题上的表现，大约需要 1600 万个提示 token。 为 200 个测试角色写入记忆，在 8 路并发下大约耗费 5000 万个任务模型 token，耗时 6 小时。

paragraphs.en: To test whether memory degrades as a history grows, we wrote only the first 25, 50, 75 or 100% of each history for 40 personas of the benchmark split and asked the 296 questions whose evidence lies in the first quarter (Figure 7 ). Reglos stays between 55.7% and 60.5%, from 59.1% at the first quarter to 60.5% with the full history, and leads at every prefix, by 1.0 to 5.1 points over raw retrieval and by 3.7 to 10.5 points over the full history, both with our policy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验记忆是否会随着历史记录的增长而退化，我们针对基准测试划分中的40个人设，仅写入每段历史记录的前25%、50%、75%或100%，并询问证据位于第一季度的296个问题（图7）。 Reglos保持在55.7%到60.5%之间，从第一季度的59.1%到使用完整历史记录时的60.5%，并且在每个前缀长度上都领先，分别比使用我们策略的原始检索高出1.0到5.1分，比使用我们策略的完整历史记录高出3.7到10.5分。

paragraphs.en: Each accepted change, from how a request to forget is recorded to what recall asks for, began as a failure trace that the coding agent read and turned into code.
paragraphs.zh: 每一处被接受的修改——从「遗忘请求如何被记录」到「回忆（recall）请求什么」——最初都是一条失败轨迹，由编码智能体读取并转化为代码。

paragraphs.en: In our development audit about half of the remaining errors could not be answered from the history at all, which puts the ceiling for a perfect reader near 80%, and most of the reachable half are reader decisions bounded by the task model’s ability ( Zhou 2026 ) . Preferences that belong to other people stay below chance for every system: a preference stated about a sister or a colleague is extracted as the user’s, and every later layer trusts it. The fix belongs in the write path, with provenance that survives consolidation.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的开发审计中，大约一半的剩余错误根本无法从历史记录中得到答案，这使得一个完美读取器的上限接近 80%，而可达的一半中大多数是受任务模型能力限制的读取器决策（Zhou 2026）。 属于其他人的偏好对所有系统而言都低于随机水平：关于姐妹或同事的偏好被提取为用户的偏好，而后续每一层都信任它。 修复应属于写入路径，并带有能在整合中存留的来源信息。

paragraphs.en: The next step in the taxonomy of Duan et al. (2026) is a loop that chooses which experience to gather. The product already records when users correct, delete or undo a memory; turning those events into the failure traces the proposer reads, behind the same evaluator, is the step we are taking next ( Liang et al. 2026b ; Xue et al. 2026 ) . A second direction is to stop holding the model fixed. Everything here was gained with a frozen model, and most errors that memory can still fix are reader decisions, so training the model that writes and reads memory is the complementary step. Reinforcement learning on memory construction and use is an active direction ( Wang et al. 2025 ; Yan et al. 2025 ) , an RL-trained 4B agentic memory reaches 55.2% on PersonaMem-v2 ( Jiang et al. 2025b ) , and harness search can alternate with training on the policy ( Wei et al. 2026 ) . Further on, the record’s operations (add, supersede, retract, consolidate, recall) could become the training objective of a memory foundation model. A third direction is modality: in our benchmark runs images enter memory only as captions, and the record, recall and redaction should extend to images, voice and the screen, under the same rules for supersession and forgetting.
paragraphs.zh: Duan 等人（2026）分类体系中的下一步，是一个选择要收集哪些经验的循环。产品已经记录了用户何时修正、删除或撤销一条记忆；把这些事件转化为提议者所读取的失败轨迹，并置于同一个评估器之下，是我们接下来要采取的步骤（Liang et al. 2026b；Xue et al. 2026）。第二个方向是不再把模型固定不变。本文所有结果都是在冻结模型的情况下获得的，而记忆仍能修复的大多数错误属于读取方的决策，因此训练负责写入和读取记忆的模型是互补性的步骤。围绕记忆构建与使用的强化学习是一个活跃的方向（Wang et al. 2025；Yan et al. 2025），一个经 RL 训练的 4B 智能体记忆在 PersonaMem-v2 上达到了 55.2%（Jiang et al. 2025b），而测试框架搜索可以与策略训练交替进行（Wei et al. 2026）。更进一步，记录的操作（添加、取代、撤回、合并、召回）可以成为记忆基础模型的训练目标。第三个方向是模态：在我们的基准测试运行中，图像仅以说明文字的形式进入记忆，而记录、召回和删改应当扩展到图像、语音和屏幕，并在取代与遗忘方面遵循同样的规则。

paragraphs.en: We presented Reglos, a personal memory agent whose two loops co-evolve at two time scales: each user’s memory evolves online in an append-only record, and the harness that turns memory into context evolves offline through patches that a coding agent proposes and a fixed evaluator scores. With one frozen open 27B model and a training-free pipeline, Reglos outperforms the memory systems we compared on PersonaMem-v2, LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with either answering model, and exceeds the best published result under PersonaMem-v2’s official protocol. Its main limit is the reader itself: most errors that memory can still fix are decisions made with the evidence in view. We plan to feed users’ own corrections back into the outer loop as experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Reglos，一个个人记忆智能体，其两个回路在两个时间尺度上协同演化：每个用户的记忆在只追加记录中在线演化，而将记忆转化为上下文的框架则通过补丁离线演化，补丁由编程智能体提出、由固定的评估器打分。 借助一个冻结的开源 27B 模型和免训练的流程，Reglos 在 PersonaMem-v2、LongMemEval-S 和 LoCoMo 上，无论使用哪个回答模型，都优于我们所比较的记忆系统，并在 PersonaMem-v2 的官方协议下超越了已发表的最佳结果。 它的主要局限在于阅读器本身：记忆仍能修复的大多数错误，都是在证据可见的情况下做出的决策。 我们计划将用户自己的修正作为经验反馈到外层回路中。

paragraphs.en: The kernel consists of a memory library, a memory service that exposes it over HTTP, and a model service that presents an OpenAI-compatible interface and fails over between providers on network errors, rate limits and server errors. Embeddings are 1024-dimensional columns on facts, conversation chunks and sessions. An exact scan of one user’s facts takes milliseconds. Jobs (extraction, re-indexing and Dream) are rows that workers claim under a ten-minute lease, so several instances share the work without coordinating.
paragraphs.zh: 内核由一个记忆库、一个通过 HTTP 暴露该记忆库的记忆服务，以及一个模型服务组成；模型服务提供与 OpenAI 兼容的接口，并在网络错误、速率限制和服务器错误时在多个提供商之间进行故障转移。 嵌入是事实、对话片段和会话上的 1024 维向量列。 对单个用户的事实的精确扫描只需几毫秒。 任务（提取、重建索引和 Dream）是数据行，工作进程在十分钟租约下认领这些行，因此多个实例无需协调即可共享工作。

paragraphs.en: Every memory is a fact row with a statement, a predicate, the entity it is about, a perspective (an objective fact, a belief or preference of the user, or something the assistant said), a confidence, and the identifiers of its source messages. Two time axes are stored separately: the interval during which the fact holds ( valid from , valid to ) and the system’s own timeline ( ingested at , and expired at once the row is retired). Only the validity and expiry fields of a row ever change. When a new statement supersedes an old one, the old row receives an end of validity and stays in the record, so a question about an earlier period can still be answered. A request to forget expires the matching facts with a reason, and a tombstone fact records the request so that recall, summaries and the profile all honor it. A fact matches when its cosine similarity to the request is at least 0.68 or its trigram overlap at least 0.6; a request to forget expires at most six facts and a correction at most two, and background the user entered deliberately is never expired.
paragraphs.zh: 每条记忆都是一个事实行，包含一条陈述、一个谓词、所针对的实体、一个视角（客观事实、用户的信念或偏好，或智能体曾说过的话）、一个置信度，以及其来源消息的标识符。 两条时间轴被分开存储：事实成立的时间区间（生效时间、失效时间）和系统自身的时间线（摄取时间，以及该行被弃用时的过期时间）。 只有行的有效性和过期字段会发生变化。 当一条新陈述取代旧陈述时，旧行会获得一个失效时间并保留在记录中，因此关于较早时期的提问仍然可以得到回答。 遗忘请求会以某个原因使匹配的事实过期，并用一个墓碑事实记录该请求，以便召回、摘要和用户画像都遵守它。 当一个事实与请求的余弦相似度至少为 0.68，或其三元组重叠度至少为 0.6 时，即视为匹配；一次遗忘请求最多使六个事实过期，一次更正最多使两个事实过期，而用户有意输入的背景信息永不过期。

paragraphs.en: Incoming turns pass through a buffer and a redaction step that replaces keys, card numbers and identity numbers with placeholders. The model then proposes candidate facts, commitments and retractions. A candidate whose normalized key (case, width, spacing and punctuation) matches a stored fact only confirms that fact, and a single batch call decides for each remaining candidate whether it is new, a duplicate, a replacement, a coexisting fact or an enrichment of an existing one. Facts, summaries and the profile are stored in the language of the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 传入的轮次会经过一个缓冲区和一个脱敏步骤，该步骤将密钥、卡号和身份号码替换为占位符。 然后模型提出候选事实、承诺和撤回。 其规范化键（大小写、全角半角、空格和标点）与已存储事实匹配的候选仅会确认该事实，而一次批量调用会决定每个其余候选是新事实、重复项、替换项、可共存的事实还是对现有事实的补充。 事实、摘要和个人资料均以对话所使用的语言存储。

paragraphs.en: The three content routes are dense vector search, keyword search and traversal of the entity graph. The two anchor routes match a time window, interpreted in the configured time zone against both when a fact was recorded and when its event happened, and a scene or location. A question that names no time skips the time route. Fusion is weighted reciprocal rank fusion ( k = 60 k=60 ), cut to 45 items and packed in rank order into 8,100 tokens; both limits widen for questions that ask to enumerate. Each route has a 2.5-second timeout, and a route that times out is reported while the others’ results are returned. For every item, explain returns the routes that found it, its rank on each, its fusion contribution and its validity state.
paragraphs.zh: 三条内容检索路径是稠密向量检索、关键词检索以及实体图遍历。 两条锚点路径分别是匹配一个时间窗口——按配置的时区解释，同时对照事实被记录的时间和其事件发生的时间——以及匹配一个场景或地点。 未提及任何时间的问题会跳过时间路径。 融合采用加权倒数排名融合（k=60），截取45个条目，并按排名顺序打包进8,100个token；对于要求枚举的问题，这两个上限都会放宽。 每条路径有2.5秒的超时时间，超时的路径会被报告，同时返回其他路径的结果。 对于每个条目，explain 会返回找到它的路径、它在每条路径上的排名、它的融合贡献及其有效性状态。

paragraphs.en: Dream flushes the write buffer, summarizes each session, rebuilds the profile from the user’s current facts and rewrites it. It runs for each user once a night after an hour of inactivity, and a session pending for more than thirty hours is scheduled regardless of the hour. Consolidation never deletes rows of the record; it produces summaries and the profile, which recall draws on next to the facts and raw excerpts.
paragraphs.zh: Dream 会刷新写入缓冲区，对每个会话进行摘要，并根据用户当前的事实重建并重写档案。 它每晚为每个用户运行一次，需在该用户不活动一小时后；而等待超过三十小时的会话无论何时都会被安排执行。 整合从不删除记录中的行；它会生成摘要和档案，供召回在使用事实和原始摘录时一并取用。

paragraphs.en: A self-improving system can be described by its components, with its autonomy graded in levels ( Duan et al. 2026 ) . The components include the target the system changes, the experience it learns from, the improver and the verifier. Table 8 maps both loops of Reglos onto this framework.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自我改进系统可以通过其组成部分来描述，其自主性按等级划分（Duan et al. 2026）。 这些组成部分包括系统所改变的目标、其学习所用的经验、改进者和验证者。 表 8 将 Reglos 的两个循环映射到该框架上。

sents.en: A self-improving system can be described by its components, with its autonomy graded in levels ( Duan et al. 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 一个自我改进系统可以通过其组成部分来描述，其自主性按等级划分（Duan et al. 2026）。

sents.en: The components include the target the system changes, the experience it learns from, the improver and the verifier.
sents.zh: 这些组成部分包括系统所改变的目标、其学习所用的经验、改进者和验证者。

sents.en: Table 8 maps both loops of Reglos onto this framework.
sents.zh: 表 8 将 Reglos 的两个循环映射到该框架上。

paragraphs.en: The inner loop is what the product does for every user every day. Its target is persistent state, the experience is the user’s own interaction, and the rules under which the state may change are fixed: the pipeline deletes nothing (only the user can), supersession keeps history, forgetting is a retraction with a tombstone, consolidation adds derived layers and leaves facts unchanged, and the user can override any of it. In the framework this is environment-adaptation autonomy, and it is what the broader literature calls a self-evolving memory ( Gao et al. 2026 ; Fang et al. 2025 ) . The pipeline that writes memory changes only through the outer loop, which is how the two loops co-evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 内循环是产品每天为每个用户所做的事情。 它的目标是持久状态，体验是用户自身的交互，而状态可以变更的规则是固定的：流水线不删除任何内容（只有用户可以删除），替代保留历史，遗忘是带有墓碑标记的撤回，整合添加派生层并保持事实不变，且用户可以覆盖其中任何规则。 在本框架中，这属于环境适应自主性，也正是更广泛的文献所称的自进化记忆（Gao 等，2026；Fang 等，2025）。 写入记忆的流水线只能通过外循环来改变，这正是两个循环共同进化的方式。

paragraphs.en: The outer loop changes the code. Its target is everything between the frozen task model and the kernel: how facts are extracted and merged, how a request to forget is applied, what recall is asked for, how evidence is laid out, and what the policy says. The critic is a model from a different family than the proposer; it clusters the failures independently and checks every proposal against a shortcut rule: no logic keyed to the dataset’s option templates, to the labels of who holds a preference, or to how the generic option is constructed. The verifier is a frozen script that applies the rule of Figure 4 to every candidate after the freeze.
paragraphs.zh: 外层循环负责修改代码。 它的目标是介于冻结任务模型与内核之间的一切内容：事实如何被抽取与合并、遗忘请求如何被执行、请求何种召回、证据如何呈现，以及策略如何规定。 评论者是与提出者不同家族的模型；它独立地对失败进行聚类，并依据一条捷径规则检查每项提议：不得使用任何与数据集选项模板、与谁持有偏好的标签、或与通用选项构造方式相关联的逻辑。 验证者是一个冻结的脚本，在冻结之后对每个候选项应用图 4 的规则。

paragraphs.en: In the framework this is strategy autonomy, the level of Self-Harness ( Zhang et al. 2026c ) , and Meta-Harness ( Lee et al. 2026b ) works the same way: the coding agent decides what to change and people decide what counts. The improver and the verifier stay fixed, so the loop stops short of recursive inheritance (L5), where they too would be revised.
paragraphs.zh: 在该框架中，这属于策略自主，Self-Harness（Zhang et al. 2026c）和 Meta-Harness（Lee et al. 2026b）的层级运作方式相同：智能体决定改什么，人来决定什么算数。 改进器和验证器保持固定，因此该循环在递归继承（L5）之前就停止了——在那一层级，改进器和验证器本身也会被修改。

paragraphs.en: During development the loop tuned on small slices of the validation split and checked progress on a separate slice at milestones. After the freeze we divided the validation personas into two persona-disjoint halves and excluded every persona inspected during development, which leaves 1,317 questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发过程中，该循环在验证集的小切片上进行调优，并在里程碑节点使用单独的切片检查进度。 冻结之后，我们将验证集智能体角色划分为互不重叠的两半，并排除开发期间检查过的所有智能体角色，最终留下 1,317 个问题。

paragraphs.en: During development a change was kept when it did not lower accuracy on the tuning slices, and it replaced the current harness once it gained about 3 points. This margin proved close to run-to-run noise, so after the freeze we adopted the stricter rule of Figure 4 , with GPT-5.6 Luna as the second reader.
paragraphs.zh: 开发期间，某项改动只要没有降低调优切片上的准确率就会被保留，当它获得约 3 分的提升时，就会取代当前的测试框架。 这一差距被证明接近于运行间的噪声，因此在冻结之后，我们采用了图 4 中更严格的规则，由 GPT-5.6 Luna 担任第二审阅者。
